scope: Final runner/installer INPUTS-only changes plus full new stage/bootstrap source review and local actual AO/AN binding checks. Prior formal architecture and boundary suites were not repeated.

new_stager_review.unbound_gate: Missing final inputs closes main/stage/validate_final_payload before any external operation. Exact AO source/probe and accepted AN Geometry shapes are required.
new_stager_review.publication_chain: New formal publication must be full40hex, differ from AO and AN, and descend from AO. Executed stager bytes must equal that publication. Repaired source-only bytes at AO and formal publication plus formal canonical source must match9107/eb78.
new_stager_review.proof_of_only_input_changes: Both final runner and installer raw bytes must match fixed final fingerprints. Their sole top-level literal INPUTS assignment must equal runtime_inputs; restoring INPUTS=None must yield the exact previously reviewed44560/ec53 and9775/7471 bytes. Both payloads are validated before either is copied.
new_stager_review.write_scope: Only same-publication run_dictionary.py and install_dictionary_source.py under their respective published-entrypoints plus a staging receipt. No Lean source installation, import/execution of these owners, checkout, normal build or kernel command. Existing differing files are rejected; exclusive creation uses O_NOFOLLOW and fsync.
new_stager_review.Git_preservation: HEAD, status, worktree diff and index diff fingerprints must match before/after before success.

new_bootstrap_review.unbound_gate: Missing stager fingerprint or AO identity rejects before fetch/write/run.
new_bootstrap_review.execution_chain: Requires a new AO-descendant publication distinct from AO/AN, reads the exact final stager fingerprint, rejects unbound stager, copies only that stager, and runs its stage entrypoint. It does not run installer or formal runner.
new_bootstrap_review.preservation: Checks original four Git states before stager execution and after it; writes only its staging bootstrap receipt; errors report HOLD and no acceptance.

boundary.runtime_checks_still_required: Original live AO result/command/source/context, retained failed AM tree, original accepted AN Geometry reader, D288/W58, AI/AG context, and same-new-publication installer/formal receipts remain mandatory at execution.
